title: CreatePipe
used_for: Requested size is advisory; a full anonymous-pipe synchronous write waits for a reader; original handles noninheritable when security attributes NULL.

title: WriteFile
used_for: Synchronous call completes before return; full pipe can wait; pending input buffer must remain valid.

title: GetNamedPipeInfo
used_for: Supports anonymous handles; exposes endpoint flags and input/output buffer sizes; zero means dynamically allocated, not a finite guaranteed quota.

title: PeekNamedPipe
used_for: NULL buffer can query queued-byte count without copying content; synchronous multi-thread contention can block, so sole-owner prelaunch use and outer deadline remain needed.
